import numpy as np

def ppo_update(old_probs, new_probs, advantages, clip_epsilon=0.2):
    r = new_probs / (old_probs + 1e-8)
    r_clipped = np.clip(r, 1 - clip_epsilon, 1 + clip_epsilon)
    surrogate1 = r * advantages
    surrogate2 = r_clipped * advantages
    return np.minimum(surrogate1, surrogate2)
